senses.gloss: (variously corrupted, v. infra) m. pl. (στροφώματα) pivots, pins at top and bottom of a door turning in sockets.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 66">Gen. R. s. 66</cite> <he>כמין א׳ הדלתות וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>איסטריפומיטא</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 115">Yalk. Gen. 115</cite> <cite ref="A01414"><he>איסטדומוטא</he></cite>) pivotlike, the doors could be doubled backward. [Yalk. l. c. may be read <he>אסטרופוטא</he> στρόφωμτος, v. LXX, <cite ref="Ezekiel 41:24">Ezek. XLI, 24</cite>.] <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 4:1">Midd. IV, 1</cite> <he>איצטרבאמוטא</he> Ar., ed. <he>איצטרמיטה</he> (corr. as above). Pesik. B’shall. p. 86ᵇ; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 152">Yalk. Sam. 152</cite> <he>כאילין אמפומטא</he> &c. (corr. acc.) like doors turning in sockets.
